Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the media outlet with its publishing entity and ignored the “co-founder” phrasing. Despite evidence indicating Andrew Jaspan founded/co-founded The Conversation (the not-for-profit media outlet), the Planner incorrectly finalized “The Conversation Trust (UK)”—the UK publisher—rather than the outlet itself, and prematurely marked the task complete without reconciling this mismatch.
